sloka: शरौ प्रतिहतौ दृष्ट्वा तावुभौ रणमूर्धनि।व्रीडितौ जातरोषौ च लक्ष्मणेन्द्रजितौ तदा ।। ६.९१.५४ ।।
transliteration: śarau pratihatau dṛṣṭvā tāvubhau raṇamūrdhani।vrīḍitau jātaroṣau ca lakṣmaṇendrajitau tadā ।। 6.91.54 ।।

translations.english: In the battle both of them touching each other in conflict like the major planets flew into a hundred pieces and fell on earth.
